system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Hey <USER> , just curious: do you have any data on how much Pink Floyd - Fletcher Memorial Home has been played since November 9th 2016?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! We don’t have specific play data for songs, but you can check out your listening stats at <URL>. Let us know how it goes! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply lacks clarity and personalization; URL placeholder should be replaced or removed."}
